caveats: Predictions, not measurements. Research use only; not for clinical decisions.
Under expression conditioning every track except single-cell expression is imputed from the cell embedding.
AML states come from Seq-Well data; compare them with the Seq-Well normal states, not with reference conditions.
Rearrangement breakpoints are representative, not patient-specific.
Trans effects of DNMT3A/TET2/IDH mutations are only visible through the cell-state conditioning.
